name: a-town-night
mode: image-to-video from the night town plate (design3/site/assets/plates/business-night.webp), fit pad to 16:9
prompt: Exactly as in the image: a handmade miniature diorama of an Indian snack business seen from above at night, lit by warm windows and street lamps, a pale factory with two brick chimneys and a small office at the left, a corrugated godown warehouse full of brown cartons in the middle, a lane of colourful kirana shops at the right, a highway climbing to a small warehouse on a hill at the back right, a community kitchen with a blue awning at the back, and a thin softly glowing green path painted along the road. Over the clip the tiny yellow forklift rolls slowly out of the godown onto its forecourt, the small blue truck at the factory's loading bay pulls away slowly along the road toward the godown, the white van drives slowly up the highway, and a few tiny people walk about the kirana lane and the godown's gate. The glowing green path brightens gently once and settles. Every building stays exactly where it is, with the same shape, size and colours; nothing new appears; no text appears anywhere. Locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom. Calm night light, the windows and lamps stay lit, no lens flare, no flicker.
encode: ffmpeg -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -profile:v high -crf 25 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart (from LTX's own H.264)
use: SC-60 option A, The film: the hero's film by night (dark mode), playing once over the night plate as its poster
